title: Two more community projects in the showcase
summary:
Two community apps joined the showcase while image prompt handling and caching got a closer look.

The Creative & Interactive Applications list added @mangofoxplay’s Roblox game Watch TV with neko, where players can chat with AI characters and each other, and @andreas_11’s PixPax, a chat-based app for analyzing, remixing, and creating images.

Image requests from configured referrers now take a separate prompt path that generates a semantic opposite. The same PR lowered the image queue’s rejection threshold, removed Claude 3.5 Haiku from the available text models, and adjusted Mistral’s default temperature.

A Cloudflare Worker was added to cache image requests by URL path and normalized query parameters, forwarding cache misses to the image origin. Requests outside the prompt path and requests marked no-cache bypass it. The PR also removed the pollinations.diy app files from the repository.
